description: This file implements the MediaFrameWriterV1 class, which handles writing media frames and associated metadata into shared memory buffers for media streaming. It includes methods for writing metadata, media data, and type-specific information for audio and video segments.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV1
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames and metadata into shared memory buffers, supporting different media segment types and ensuring proper space management.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1::writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment into shared memory, including metadata and media data, and updates internal counters.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1::writeMetaDataGeneric
methods.description: Writes generic metadata for a media segment, including data length, timestamp, ID, and extra data.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1::writeMetaDataTypeSpecific
methods.description: Writes type-specific metadata for audio or video segments, such as sample rate, channels, width, and height.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV1::writeData
methods.description: Writes the actual media data into shared memory, updating the data offset and byte counters.
